$comment: Source-of-truth register for every self-hosted game bundle. `npm run sync:games` mirrors each folder listed here into public/play/<slug>/ so the site works with zero cloud services. Never add a game here without also recording its licence — src/pages/licenses.json.ts publishes this file's licence data and scripts/validate-content.mjs rejects the build if a licence is missing or forbidden.

license.author: Gabriele Cirulli
license.assetsLicense: Clear Sans font by Intel, Apache-2.0

modifications: Removed the in-page paragraph pointing to the author's own hosted version, so the bundled copy does not send visitors away mid-game. No game logic was touched.
games.trademarkNote: "2048" is the original author's own title for his own original work. Nothing to rename.

games.title: Block Drop

license.author: Dionysis Zindros
license.attributionRendered: Block Drop, based on canvas-tetris by Dionysis Zindros · MIT License

modifications: Renamed js/tetris.js to js/blocks.js and updated the script tag in index.html.
Changed the document title from "HTML5 Tetris" to "Block Drop".

Added js/touch.js — a new, purely additive file giving the game touch controls on phones and tablets. It calls the same global keyPress() entry point the upstream keyboard handler uses and does not alter any upstream game logic.
No game logic was modified.
games.trademarkNote: TETRIS is a registered trademark of the Tetris Holding, LLC. The MIT licence covers the source code only and grants no trademark rights whatsoever. This bundle must ship as "Block Drop" — the word Tetris must never appear in the title, slug, URL, meta tags, headings or body copy. scripts/validate-content.mjs enforces this on every build.

games.title: Idle Venture

license.author: bitcraft3r
license.attributionRendered: Idle Venture, based on 0xVenture Capitalist by bitcraft3r · MIT License

modifications: The upstream project is a full Next.js + MongoDB app, so it cannot run as a static bundle. This folder contains a self-contained static implementation of the same idle-clicker mechanics.
Business, manager and upgrade data (names, costs, revenues, times, multipliers, milestone boosts) is transcribed verbatim from the upstream seed route (app/api/player/business/seed/[id]/route.ts).
Game logic and UI (index.html, style.css, app.js) are original to this site and released under MIT so the game runs fully offline with localStorage saves.
games.trademarkNote: No trademarked names. The original project title "0xVenture Capitalist" was renamed to avoid any association with the "Capitalist" game series.
